assets.label: 近代骑兵学院
assets.assetType: industrial-era cat-mount cavalry academy with one low hall and a broad fenced training court
assets.primaryRequest: A low industrial training yard. At the near-right fence edge, the two simple timber gate leaves are swung OUTWARD to either side, leaving a wide EMPTY WALK-THROUGH GAP between the two posts, exactly as in the depth drawing. One low brick hall and precisely THREE padded open-front cat resting bays share a SINGLE INCLINED ROOF PLANE with four straight outer edges. The roof carries one small flat paw emblem. Preserve the broad hall side window. The open court contains THREE timber agility jumps. Along the near-left service edge keep TWO racks holding THREE short cavalry carbines EACH, TWO harness racks, TWO low care stations, five feed sacks and two crates, in their depth-defined positions. Keep the continuous shallow stone footing and plain sand training floor.
assets.negativeRequest: Closed gate, fence across entrance, arched gate, roof ridge, opposite roof slope, second roof, dormer, fourth bay, extra hurdle, extra weapon rack, extra supply objects, dense corrugations or dense brick texture. No animals, people, vehicle or detached shadow.
